label: CCR2216-1G-12XS-2XQ
description: MikroTik CCR2216-1G-12XS-2XQ - 16-core ARM cloud core router: 1x 1G RJ45, 12x 25G SFP28 cages and 2x 100G QSFP28 cages.
notes: MikroTik specification table: section Ethernet prints "10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 1", section Fiber prints "Number of 25G SFP28 ports: 12" and "Number of 100G QSFP28 ports: 2", section Peripherals prints "Serial console port: RJ45" and "Number of M.2 slots: 2". The product text agrees: "There are 2x QSFP28 cages for blazing-fast 100 Gigabit connectivity, 12x SFP28 cages for 25 Gigabit networking, and a Gigabit Ethernet port." The single copper jack is a 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 socket (eth1) and the twelve cages are SFP28, so all three groups declare their connector; the copper jack declares the three copper rates the table names, while the SFP28 cages keep the cage default ladder (25G/10G/1G modules) and the QSFP28 cages the 100G/40G ladder, because the vendor states no other module for this board. The manual section "QSFP28" names CCR2216 explicitly: those interfaces run 1x 100G or 1x 40G natively and can be set to a breakout mode (2x 50G, 4x 25G, 4x 10G, 4x 1G); breakout sub-interfaces are not modelled as separate ports in this catalogue. No PoE in either direction, no USB data ports. Sources: https://mikrotik.com/product/ccr2216_1g_12xs_2xq and https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/wired-connections/mikrotik-wired-interface-compatibility/
